'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Eastern Ukraine campaign]]
***[[Battle of Toretsk]]
****The military administrator of the city of [[Toretsk]] in [[Donetsk Oblast]], [[Ukraine]], reports that more than half of the city has been taken by [[Russian Armed Forces]], with the [[Armed Forces of Ukraine]] fighting back at eight different locations. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukrainian-forces-hold-around-half-toretsk-trying-beat-back-russian-advance-local-2024-10-11/ (Reuters)]
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**Two [[United Nations peacekeeping|United Nations peacekeeper]]s are injured when [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli forces]] fire at a watchtower at their headquarters in [[Southern Lebanon|southern]] [[Lebanon]]. [https://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2024/10/11/eu-condemns-attack-on-un-peacekeeping-headquarters-in-lebanon (Euronews)]
**The [[Lebanese Armed Forces]] reports that two of its soldiers were killed in an [[Israel]]i strike on one of its positions in southern Lebanon. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2024/10/11/israel-targets-lebanese-military-post-in-southern-lebanon-killing-two-army (Al Arabiya)]
**A drone launched from Lebanon damages a building and causes a [[power outage]] in [[Herzliya]], Israel. [https://crisis24.garda.com/alerts/2024/10/israel-drone-attack-damages-building-and-causes-power-outage-in-herzliya-late-oct-11 (Crisis 24)] [https://www.mtv.com.lb/en/News/International/1500269/lebanese-drones-cross-longest-distance-yet--hit-herzliya-in-tel-aviv (MTV Lebanon)]
**Israel destroys an [[Iranian Red Crescent Society]] [[field hospital]] on the [[Lebanon–Syria border]]. [https://english.news.cn/20241011/18c50dba36ab4d028c5e5e196bb9860c/c.html (Xinhua)]
*[[Gaza war]]
**At least 20 [[Palestinians]] are killed and dozens of others are injured by [[Israel]]i [[airstrike]]s on the [[Jabalia]] refugee camp in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/thousands-said-trapped-jabalia-camp-israel-escalates-attacks-northern-gaza-2024-10-11/ (Reuters)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[2024 Nobel Peace Prize]]
**This year's [[2024 Nobel Peace Prize|Nobel Peace Prize]] is awarded to Japanese atomic bomb survivors group [[Nihon Hidankyo]] for "its efforts to achieve a world free of nuclear weapons and for demonstrating through witness testimony that nuclear weapons must never be used again". [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2024/10/11/nobel-peace-prize-2024-nihon-hidankyo/?itid=hp_alert (''The Washington Post'')] [https://www.nobelprize.org/nobel-peace-prize-2024-nihon-hidankyo/ (Nobel Prize)]

'''Business and economy''' 
*[[2024 Boeing machinists strike]]
**[[Aerospace manufacturer|Aerospace]] company [[Boeing]] announces it will cut 17,000 jobs, 10% of its global workforce, and delay the deliveries of its [[Boeing 777X]] planes due to effects of the ongoing [[machinist]]s [[strike action|strike]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/aerospace-defense/boeing-cut-17000-jobs-delay-first-777x-delivery-strike-hits-finances-2024-10-11/ (Reuters)]
*[[King of Belgium]] [[Philippe of Belgium|Philippe]] and [[King of the Netherlands]] [[Willem-Alexander of the Netherlands|Willem-Alexander]] jointly open the Nieuwe Sluis canal lock in [[Terneuzen]], [[Netherlands]], which is part of a series of locks connecting the [[Western Scheldt]] to the [[Port of Ghent]]. [https://nos.nl/artikel/2540347-koningen-willem-alexander-en-filip-openen-megasluis-in-terneuzen (NOS)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 South American wildfires]]
**[[2024 Peru wildfires]]
***The Global Wildfire Information System states that 10,400 [[wildfire]]s have been reported in [[Peru]] so far this year, more than twice as many as were reported in 2020, and that the wildfires burned an area nearly 2.5 times larger than those in 2020. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/record-wildfires-ravage-perus-ecosystems-wildlife-2024-10-11/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 Tamil Nadu train collision]]
**At least 19 people were injured after two trains collided near Chennai in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu. [https://www.indiatoday.in/india/story/chennai-mysore-darbhanga-bagmati-express-collision-accident-tamil-nadu-derailment-fire-2615690-2024-10-12 (India Today)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Foreign relations of Nicaragua]], [[Foreign relations of Israel]]
**[[Nicaragua]] formally breaks off [[diplomacy|diplomatic relations]] with Israel, calling the [[Israeli government]] "[[fascist (insult)|fascist]]" and "[[Palestinian genocide accusation|genocidal]]". [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/nicaragua-breaks-diplomatic-relations-with-israel-2024-10-11/ (Reuters)]
*[[France–Israel relations]], [[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**[[France]] summons the [[Israel]]i ambassador to France over recent attacks against  [[United Nations peacekeeping|United Nations peacekeeper]]s in [[Lebanon]], calling the attacks a violation of international law and asking Israel to explain itself. [https://www.lemonde.fr/en/international/article/2024/10/11/france-summons-israeli-envoy-after-attack-on-un-peacekeepers-in-lebanon_6729089_4.html (''Le Monde'')]
